thread:
ada: FYI I'm starting onboarding for optal-7b-quant (weights uploaded). Need quick sweep for legal/license + tokenizer quirks before we flip to canary.
lucy: thanks — where are the weights located? path and checksum?
sandeep: weights are at s3://redwood-models/optal/7b/optal-7b-quant.tar.zst and a symlink at /mnt/models/optal-7b
ada: checksum posted in the bucket metadata. quick verify command if helpful:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/optal/7b/optal-7b-quant.tar.zst - | zstd -d | sha256sum
```
mike: quick heads-up: our config validator failed on this model in CI for missing tokenizer_type field in model card. that will block dedicated/private deploys.
ad a: noted — tokenizer is a custom byte-bpe variant, sharing vocab in repo under infra/tokenizers/optal-bpe.json. I'll add tokenizer_type: "byte-bpe-optal" to the model_card.
lucy: legal-bot flagged the license on the original repo as "CC-BY-NC-4.0" with an extra contributor clause. legal, can we serve under hosted API? :eyes:
legal-bot: tagging @legal-team: CC-BY-NC is non-commercial; hosted usage may be considered commercial. Need explicit permission from authors or dual-licensed grant for hosted/commercial usage. Also require attribution in model_card and a clear acceptable_use section.
nina: to unblock, could we ship as Dedicated/Private only (no hosted) until license clarified?
ad a: yes we can restrict routing policy to dedicated/private via the model manifest. I'll add a flag: "serving_restrictions": ["no-hosted-api"]
sandeep: also add a model_card section:
```
license: "CC-BY-NC-4.0"
attribution: "Optal Research Lab"
acceptable_use: ["no-medical-diagnostic","no-high-risk-finance"]
known_issues: "tokenizer emits rare control bytes; use tokenizer_v2 to normalize"
```
mike: great. two operational items: (1) config validator needs schema bump to accept serving_restrictions, (2) runtime needs mapping for tokenizer_type -> tokenizer_v2 preprocessor.
infra-bot: CI check: config-schema v1.9 flagged. Open PR required: redwood/configs#2412
ada: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/configs/pull/2412 — adds serving_restrictions + tokenizer_type enum. pinged @mike for review.
mike: I'll review in ~2h.
lucy: legal, while we wait, can we get a short model_card template for the UI? Legal wants explicit wording for attribution and restrictions.
legal-bot: draft wording: "This model is provided under CC-BY-NC-4.0. Commercial hosting and sale are prohibited without explicit permission from the copyright holders. Users must display the following attribution: \"Optal Research Lab — Optal-7B\". Prohibited use-cases: clinical decision-making, automated high-value financial advising, law enforcement identification."
nina: can we add an automated gating rule so any model with non-commercial license auto-blocks hosted_publish? saves manual checks.
sandeep: yes — propose rule in onboarding pipeline: if model_card.license contains "NC" OR model_card.acceptable_use contains high-risk tags => set model.state = "restricted" and add required_signoff: ["legal"].
ad a: I'll add that to the onboarding checklist and update the onboarding playbook doc: infra/onboarding.md
mike: small note — tokenizer normalization fix: replace bytes <0x20 with U+FFFD in tokenizer_v2 to avoid runtime crash on streaming. Add a unit test.
ada: added test and linked PR for tokenizer: https://github.com/redwood/tokenizers/pull/834
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary for tokenizers not yet rolled. Waiting on tokenizers PR merge and config-schema PR. Status: blocked -> awaiting code-review.
lucy: timeline check — if legal gets author permission in 48h we can go hosted in a week, otherwise keep dedicated only. we should communicate to sales.
legal-bot: @sales-team FYI: Optal-7B is currently restricted; please don't promise hosted availability.
ada: thanks all — next steps: (1) finalize model_card (ada), (2) merge configs PR (mike), (3) merge tokenizer PR (sandeep/mike), (4) legal to chase authors. I'll update the onboarding ticket and mark blocked->pending-legal. :white_check_mark:
mike: ping me on the PR when ready, will fast-review.
nina: added a short checklist item to the model registry UI: "license requires hosted permission?" so registry shows a red badge.
ad a: done. leaving notes in the ticket. ttyl.
